# Leonardo Costa de Sá — AI Engineer

> I design, ship and operate GenAI systems where errors are expensive.
> I build AI systems for tax, legal, compliance and education teams. Every system
> I ship can show where its answers come from, and proves it with audit trails.

Site: https://leonardosa.pro
Contact: leonardo@leonardosa.pro
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/leonardocostadesa/
GitHub: https://github.com/leonardocostadesa
Location: Madrid, Spain (from August 2026) · CET
Languages: English (fluent), French (fluent), Portuguese (native), Spanish (intermediate)

## What I do

- Document-intelligence pipelines (RAG on Azure OpenAI, Python) with validated accuracy
- Multi-agent systems (CrewAI/LangChain) whose agents check their answers and cite sources
- Enterprise AI integration: Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure
- AI adoption programs: training, opportunity mapping, AI-enabled delivery models
- Production discipline: every AI call traced (Langfuse), errors monitored (Sentry), audit trails built in

## Experience

- **KPMG Brazil — Tax Transformation** (May 2025 – Jun 2026). Joined as AI Solutions
  Consultant, promoted to AI Engineer. Helped build a legal search engine — Legal and
  Corporate teams validated 94% of its answers. Cut task time by 30–80% on the workflows
  I automated. Trained 1,600+ professionals to use AI in their daily work.
- **Revisa Master — Co-founder & AI Engineer** (2023–present). Revisa Master reviews
  academic manuscripts. I co-founded it and I am its entire engineering department.
  I built the review platform (Django, ChromaDB, Celery, Docker, Langfuse, Sentry) and
  I keep it running in production. A review that took an expert six hours now takes
  fifteen minutes. I also built the funnels behind ~90% revenue growth in one quarter.
- **Garden São Paulo — Full Stack Developer** (2021–2023). Built the company's first
  institutional website, CRM integrations and operational automation, supporting 120%+
  revenue growth in the period.

## Selected case studies (each has a dedicated page)

- **Revisa Express** (Python, Django, CrewAI, ChromaDB): 8-agent review pipeline in
  production. Five pillar reviewers, a writer, a copy editor and a validator. A report
  takes ~13.7 minutes and costs ~$1.78; zero failed LLM calls across 210 traced calls.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/revisa-master-express
- **Document Analysis Automation** (Python, Power Automate, AI Builder, Azure Document
  Intelligence): a pipeline that read every page of 50,000+ documents (1958–present,
  handwritten to born-digital) for an $8 billion lawsuit. 98% accuracy, validated by
  KPMG lawyers on a 10% sample. Three AI tools had failed before it; a custom OCR model
  handled the hard documents. Its output became key evidence in the case. The manual
  alternative: 5 consultants for 10 days per 500-document batch, initial questions only.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/document-analysis-automation
- **KBSE — Knowledge Base Search Engine** (Python, Django, CrewAI, ChromaDB, Azure OpenAI):
  a RAG search engine for legal and regulatory questions, built in 2024 when models were
  far weaker. Four stages: retrieve, consolidate, validate, answer. Every answer links to
  its original source. 94% validated accuracy and 99% user-rated relevance, measured with
  Legal and Corporate teams over ~3 months (feedback stored in Supabase).
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/knowledge-base-search-engine
- **Tax Reform Delivery Model**: redesigned KPMG's delivery model into six phases with
  AI agents embedded where information piled up. Tax Transformation leadership presented
  30-60% efficiency gains on covered activities.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/tax-reform-delivery-model
- **Saving Time App**: an offline-first consulting app for Revisa Master consultants.
  AI turns audio into session summaries and next steps, then updates the client record
  from a mobile SQLite workflow with daily sync.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/saving-time-app
- **AI Workflow Workshop**: a 12-hour hands-on workshop where Legal, Corporate, SALT
  and Tax Transformation teams mapped real work before designing agents, prompts,
  prototypes and solution specs.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/ai-opportunity-mapping
- **AI Training for ALL**: trained 1,600+ tax professionals through real business
  problems, hybrid exercises and quarterly themes. Reached 8,000 aggregate training hours.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/ai-training-for-all
- **Lei do Bem Form Analysis**: MVP review assistant for R&D tax-incentive forms.
  Checked project, service, staff, material and third-party descriptions against Ministry
  standards while keeping consultants in the loop; saved roughly three hours per form.
  https://leonardosa.pro/solutions/lei-do-bem-form-analysis
